name: Side Plank Hip Abduction
steps: Set your lower elbow beneath your shoulder, stack your feet and lift your hips into a side plank.
Brace your obliques and glutes tightly while resting your top hand on your hip.
Raise your straight top leg smoothly upward toward the ceiling without letting your bottom hip drop.
Lower your top leg slowly back to the starting position, and switch sides after completing one side.
tips: Keep your toes pointing forward rather than twisting your top foot upward.
Bend your bottom knee to the floor for a shorter lever if your hips begin to sag.
